summary: Pluri Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 1,200,000 common shares and pre-funded warrants for up to 1,028,940 shares, priced at $1.50 per share (pre-funded at $1.49999), with concurrent private placement warrants exercisable at $1.65 for up to 2,228,940 shares. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners acted as placement agent. The offering is a capital raise, not a special situation; terms include 4.99% beneficial ownership limitation on pre-funded warrants and are subject to Form S-3 one-third market value restrictions. No special-situation category applies.
